title: 第三章 天赋刷新双修夺根大法第四章林师姐莫急这就来了
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
“吃下去！”
周荒怒呵一声，瞪视银钱子。
轰——
炼气四层的威压不再掩饰，一道灵气赐下，银钱子直接被压倒在地。
他小心转过头去，瞪大了双眼。
“你，这，炼气四层？这怎么可能！”
银钱子几乎被吓尿，若不是这股威压还存在着，并且是从周荒身上散发出来的，他绝对不敢相信。
周荒这个马上入土的小子，竟然有炼气四层的修为。
“难道他隐藏了实力？”
银钱子暗道，脑子疯狂的思考，手中还拿着那个填满毒丹的小瓶。
啪——
然而周荒直接一巴掌打断了他的思绪，将他整个人连人带瓶打飞了出去，撞到了墙上。
他一个炼气二层的修士，面对周荒根本没有一丝可反抗的机会。
周荒撸了撸袖子，将脸上的黑渣子擦去，再次来到银钱子身前。
一把抢过来小瓶，精心的为他选了一颗剧毒之丹。
妈的让你装逼，让你哥俩整日欺负我，风水轮流转，今日我就让你尝尝被欺负到底是啥滋味！
周荒的愤怒已经到达了极点，他将一枚墨绿的丹药拿出，放在银钱子眼前。
“怎么，圆满级丹药不认得了？快吃啊，你不是爱吃吗？”
银钱子疯狂摇着头，眼中泪水已经被吓了出来。
他是个识货之人，能认得出这枚丹药乃是一品中化骨丹。

吃下后，整个人的骨头会在一刻钟内化成水，而圆满级的化骨丹，不得把他的皮都给化掉啊！
想到这，银钱子再也受不了压力，胯下一热，一股臭味起来，连屎带尿全部倾泻而下。
“真他娘恶心。”
周荒捂住鼻子，忍不住骂道。
银钱子顾不得这些，扑通一声跪了下来。
“周兄，我都是被逼的啊，这些注意都是金钱子出的，和我没关系，我也是没办法啊！
您饶我一命，我发誓日后与他再无联系！”
银钱子一边哭一边磕头，试图让周荒放他一马。
然而周荒的时间宝贵，他还要修炼，可没空跟对方闲聊。
大手一挥，澎湃的灵力宛如一根根麻绳般将其捆了个结实。
而后微微用力，撬开了他的嘴，将那枚圆满级化骨丹喂了下去。
content_en:
"Eat it!"
Zhou Huang roared angrily and glared at Yin Qianzi.
Boom——
The pressure of the fourth level of Qi Refining was no longer concealed, a burst of spiritual energy was given, and Yin Qianzi was directly crushed to the ground.
He turned his head carefully and his eyes widened.
"You, here, are at the fourth level of Qi Refining? How is this possible!"
Yin Qianzi was almost scared to death. If this pressure hadn't still existed and emanated from Zhou Huang, he would never have believed it.
Zhou Huang, a boy who was about to be buried, actually had the fourth level of Qi refining.
"Is he hiding his strength?"
Yin Qianzi thought to himself, thinking crazily, still holding the vial filled with poison pills in his hand.
Snap——
However, Zhou Huang interrupted his thoughts with a slap, sending him and the bottle flying out and hitting the wall.
As a monk on the second level of Qi Refining, he had no chance to resist Zhou Huang.
Zhou Huang rolled up his sleeves, wiped away the black scum on his face, and came to Yin Qianzi again.
He grabbed the vial and carefully selected a poisonous elixir for him.
Damn it, I let you act cool, let your brothers bully me all day long, the situation has changed, today I will let you taste what it feels like to be bullied!
Zhou Huang's anger had reached its extreme. He took out a dark green pill and placed it in front of Yin Qianzi's eyes.
"What, you don't recognize the perfection-level elixir? Eat it quickly, don't you love it?"
Yin Qianzi shook his head crazily, tears in his eyes were already frightened.
He is a discerning person and can recognize that this elixir is a first-grade Zhonghua Bone elixir.
After eating it, the entire person's bones will turn into water within a quarter of an hour, and the perfection-level bone-transforming pill must not melt away his skin!
Thinking of this, Yin Qianzi couldn't stand the pressure anymore. He felt hot in his crotch, and a foul smell arose, and all his feces and urine poured out.
"That's fucking disgusting."
Zhou Huang covered his nose and couldn't help but curse.
Yin Qianzi didn't care about this and knelt down with a plop.
"Brother Zhou, I was forced to do this. All this attention was paid by Qianzi. It has nothing to do with me and I can't help it!
Please spare my life, I swear I will never contact him again in the future! "
Yin Qianzi kowtowed while crying, trying to get Zhou Huang to let him go.
However, Zhou Huang's time was precious. He still had to practice, but he had no time to chat with the other party.
With a wave of his hand, the surging spiritual power tied it up like hemp ropes.
Then with a little force, he pried open his mouth and fed the Perfect Level Bone Transformation Pill down.
